patches.name: DLNA cast
patches.description: Adds DLNA / UPnP casting to the cast button. Streams the current video or song to a DLNA media renderer on the local network. Requires the official Morphe patches (with GmsCore support). The cast button shows when a DLNA renderer is found; turn off Morphe's "Hide cast button" (on by default) to see it. Casting from the share menu works either way.
